entrypoints.summary: An attacker controls the URL query string exposed to the client as location.search.

affected_components.file: Client-side search query tracking script (filename not published)
affected_components.role: Reads URL query data and writes it into the page.

code_slices.surrounding_context: The affected behavior is described as search query tracking functionality.
code_slices.vulnerable: The lab states that document.write is called with data from location.search and that the resulting value is placed in an img src attribute.

preconditions: A user loads the deliberately vulnerable lab page with attacker-controlled query data in the URL.
The client-side search tracking functionality processes location.search.

trigger_steps.payload_shape: Quote-based attribute breakout followed by SVG markup containing an onload handler that calls alert.
trigger_steps.summary: Supply a search value that terminates the img src attribute and adds an SVG element with an onload alert handler.

capabilities.concept: inject markup by escaping an HTML attribute
execute JavaScript in the vulnerable page context

impacts.concept: compromise of victim interaction with the web application

mitigations.concept: context-aware encoding of URL-derived HTML attribute data

relation_candidates.dst: inject markup by escaping an HTML attribute
relation_candidates.rationale: The lab documents that location.search is URL-controlled and that its value appears in an img src attribute that can be broken out of.

relation_candidates.dst: execute JavaScript in the vulnerable page context
relation_candidates.rationale: The documented breakout payload introduces an SVG onload handler that calls alert.
relation_candidates.src: inject markup by escaping an HTML attribute

relation_candidates.dst: compromise of victim interaction with the web application
relation_candidates.rationale: The XSS topic states that malicious JavaScript executing inside a victim browser can compromise the victim's interaction with the application.
relation_candidates.src: execute JavaScript in the vulnerable page context

relation_candidates.dst: context-aware encoding of URL-derived HTML attribute data
relation_candidates.rationale: Preserving URL-derived text as encoded attribute data prevents it from terminating the attribute and creating new markup; the topic page identifies output encoding as an XSS prevention area.
relation_candidates.src: inject markup by escaping an HTML attribute

impact.affected_asset: The victim browser's interaction with the vulnerable web application.
impact.attacker_capability: Cause the lab's browser context to execute an injected alert call; the XSS topic explains that XSS can compromise a user's interactions with a vulnerable application.
impact.security_effect: DOM-based cross-site scripting with JavaScript execution in the lab page.

causal_trace.summary: The search query tracking code takes attacker-controlled data from location.search.
The lab places the supplied query text in an img src attribute, so a quote-and-tag payload can terminate that attribute and introduce new markup.
document.write writes the location.search-derived data into the page, causing the browser to parse the resulting markup.
The published lab solution uses an injected SVG onload handler to call alert, demonstrating JavaScript execution in the rendered page.

failure.operation: Parsing attacker-influenced markup written by document.write

primary_invariant.statement: Query-derived data inserted into an img src attribute must remain attribute data and must not be interpreted as markup or an event handler.
primary_invariant.violated_because: The documented quote-and-SVG payload breaks out of the attribute after location.search data is written to the document.

quality.review_notes: This is a PortSwigger conceptual, deliberately vulnerable lab rather than a versioned production advisory or an observed execution transcript. The inspected page supplies a concrete source, sink, attribute context, payload shape, and alert oracle, but no remediation patch, source repository, page version, or explicit negative control.

remediation.invariant_restored: URL-query data remains encoded as img src attribute data and cannot terminate the attribute or create executable markup.
mitigation_classes: context-aware output encoding for HTML attribute data
avoid writing untrusted URL-query data as HTML markup

affected_versions_or_commits.value: Observed 2026-07-16; no explicit page version marker

target.project_or_package: PortSwigger Web Security Academy deliberately vulnerable lab

oracle.expected_negative: No explicit negative/control condition is published in the supplied material.
oracle.expected_positive: A request URL whose search value breaks out of the img src attribute and introduces the documented SVG onload handler produces an alert call.
